scope.research_question: Integrate independent feature-lesson loops and actual integration proof into the Rhapsodia 0.11.0 distribution without weakening authority or creating a second control system.
scope.target: skills/local-graph-engine and skills/magia integration (same distribution working revision)

sources.title: Auto-generated video transcript: loop engineering
sources.notes: User-supplied transcript snapshot; the original video and external performance claims were not independently audited.

sources.title: RhapsodIA distribution 0.11.0 supplied ZIP
sources.notes: Immutable before-state for repository structure, existing interfaces, tests and host profiles.

findings.statement: A clean feature-builder context can repeat previously observed failures unless a separate durable learning process propagates evidence.
findings.rationale: Source-backed lesson is advisory; avoid automatic prompt rewriting.

findings.statement: The original loop freezes acceptance checks before candidate mutation and forbids an agent from lowering those checks.
findings.rationale: Existing independent gates protect evaluators; make new memory explicitly subordinate.

findings.statement: Passing isolated checks can miss actual public/UI/storage integration, leading to false feature closure.
findings.rationale: Require suitable observable consumer integration proof when the feature needs it.

findings.statement: Repeated attempts must be bounded, evaluable and scoped rather than letting an entire product run in one uncontrolled loop.
findings.rationale: Existing bounded execution and explicit stop rules already cover this.

findings.statement: The transcript advocates a special project-context skill, but context may be retained through the existing workspace graph.
findings.rationale: Avoid duplicate skill/system-of-truth; preserve source authority and existing memory.

findings.statement: Claimed improvements in the narrated demos transfer to this catalog.
findings.rationale: No paired behavioral or host cross-platform experiment on this distribution; do not claim measured improvement.

requirements.statement: Persist source-pinned independent feature episodes and return only read-only recurring-failure guidance candidates; never auto-modify instructions or evaluators.
Keep frozen independent acceptance/evaluator gates and canonical owner authority before any learned guidance is promoted.
MAGIA closure for integrated features needs observable actual consumer/public path evidence, not only isolated tests.
Preserve bounded loops, compatibility, portable core, source authority and all existing session/harness controls.

changes.summary: Add v2 source-pinned execution lessons and bounded advisory review without auto-mutation.
Add typed v2 payload preserving v1 compatibility and explicit observed/hypothetical evidence.
Add eight executable new-path/privacy/conflict/revision/legacy tests and compact direct reference.
Clarify consumer integration proof and advisory, independently gated lessons in canonical owner-bounded agent profiles; leave the coordinated MAGIA skill intact.

changes.target: AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/runtime, docs/agents and docs/releases/0.11.0.md
changes.summary: Clarify why and how to reuse lessons without copying or weakening canonical independent gates.

changes.target: skills/runtime-harness and existing workspace graph/session entrypoints
changes.summary: Keep the existing paired startup, source pins, private storage, permissions and opt-outs.
Existing independently frozen evaluators and gate ownership remain authoritative; graph lessons may not override them.

evaluations.description: Test v2 lesson review, source freshness, duplicate/conflicting failures, privacy, revision and v1 compatibility.
evaluations.limitation: Local CLI behavioral proof; agent-reported evidence requires independent inspection.

evaluations.description: Existing Local Graph Engine regression suite.
evaluations.limitation: Nonexecuted optional adapters remain unverified on this platform.
Static checks do not prove native host invocation or model following.

evaluations.description: Direct top-100 control and semantically relevant owner/verifier invariants checked against immutable ZIP.
evaluations.limitation: Human-readable contract review, not a paired model-behavior benchmark.
